alias_normalization_policy: Aliases are noun phrases only (no full clauses / embedded negation). semantic_constraints.concept uses Turkish canonical noun; aliases may appear in utterance surface.
preferences_policy: preferences mirror positive concepts only; category_hint:* forbidden in sanitized gold
semantic_constraints_policy: positive=EXPLICIT wanted concepts; negative=EXPLICIT_NEGATION rejected; corrections=USER_CORRECTION replacement concept; positive∩negative must be empty
category_hint_policy: REMOVED from sanitized train. Prompt forbids category IDs/fixture keys; category_hint:MOBILE_PHONE-style prefs are out of contract for this dataset.
